findings.label: Link columns capped at 3
findings.detail: linkColumns = columns.slice().sort(...).slice(0, 3) renders all enabled columns only up to 3 slots; a 4th+ configured column is silently dropped. The shipped default and admin data have exactly 3 columns, and the authoritative design doc (§5/§13) explicitly accepts 'up to available slots', so this is not blocking. Revisit the grid template and slice if >3 columns are ever required.
findings.spec: Original user spec §5 'Use ALL enabled admin-managed footer columns' vs design doc §5 'up to available slots' decision.
